snippet.title: Windblown - Sanctuary Update Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get your first look at the Sanctuary Update for Windblown, the next game from the crafters of Deadcells! Brave the Vortex and dash your way to greatness in this lightning-fast action roguelite for 1-3 players. Absorb the powers of fallen warriors, rebuild their weapons, and WIPE THE FLOOR with those Sentinels in search of that perfect run!
